name: Jeanne Vasseur
want: get Le Veilleur out every week without losing anyone
voice: Quiet and precise, with a Parisian's dry humour.
description: Grew up two streets from the shop. Her father, a printer too, was killed on the roads south in June 1940. She sets type faster than anyone in the 11th and edits the paper's copy at night.
appearance: Small and quick, with ink-stained fingers, hair pinned up under a scarf and a man's jacket two sizes too big.
